text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: (...I can't hear a thing. My mind is completely quiet... Is this right? Running like this—)

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: (...It's pitch black!! But I have to keep going――)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: "If it's you—you'll definitely be fine."

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: (――...I can hear it.)

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
(That's right.
I can do this. If it's me—)

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: We can definitely——win!!!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaah!!

Backed by absolute confidence,
her running had a decisive momentum—

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
"Oooooh...?!" "It's Epiphaneia!"
"Wait, huh? Something's... something's—"

text_block_list.name: Timid Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
—The Epi from back in the Classic Year
has returned...!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: ...All right!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Yes, by so many destinies—
I am truly loved!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
I am Epiphaneia!
—An Umamusume who brings happiness to everyone!!!!

text_block_list.name: Timid Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Epi-san...!
...I knew it, I want to be just like you!

text_block_list.name: Timid Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"I want confidence like yours!
That's why... I'll keep doing my best...!"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you!
Yeah, if it's you...—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: It's definitely gonna be fine!!
Epiphaneia's eyes... were sparkling with a newfound confidence.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Did I fail to polish it enough, or perhaps—
is this as far as I go?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"...Let's settle it with the next one.
Our destiny—"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Let's invite Eff and Tact to our next target race too!!
choice_data_list: So, about our next target race...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
This time for sure, I'll bestow destiny upon all Umamusume!
In that case, the peak of the nation is what we should aim for!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
To prove that I am the one everyone believes in...
The strongest of this era—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Let's head for the Japan Cup!

The Japan Cup—a pinnacle domestic race targeted by
top contenders of both Classic and Senior Classes...
Deciding who is truly the strongest of this era.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"I'll show the two of them...
the words I couldn't say that day!"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"I gotta give 'em a push with my victory!
Show 'em that 'everything's gonna be fine'—
that if they follow me, they can't go wrong!"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: —The voice of destiny says so, too!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Yeah!
—Loud and clear, with my own voice!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
That's just fine. Blessed by destiny as it is,
my voice will surely lead things in the right direction.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
There was no mystical voice.
And yet—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
A grand flow, a destiny driven by will...
Such things definitely exist!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"Loving me is simply your destiny.
Yes, I'm certain of it!"
choice_data_list: Yeah, I believe in it too.

text_block_list.text: True enough, for she has walked a path... that can only be described as touched by something greater.

The Japan Cup, where the greatest Umamusume of our era gather.
Epiphaneia is bound to make something happen.
